info.title: Brello Public API
info.description: Public SDK ingestion, scoped read endpoints, API key lifecycle, and outgoing signed webhooks. Read spend is SDK estimated cost; it is not a complete provider invoice. SDK content is not collected.

EventBatch.description: Events are validated independently for partial acceptance. Body limits are UTF-8 bytes. Authenticated project and environment are never taken from this payload.

LlmRequestEvent.description: One completed provider attempt. Delivery retries reuse the event UUID; a new provider attempt gets a new UUID. Content is not collected in beta. Unknown fields are rejected; legacy content/prompt/completion/messages fields are discarded before validation.

ProviderKeyReference.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the provider secret, never the secret itself. A redacted hint is optional and is only a heuristic matching signal.

IdentifiedEndUserReference.description: Application user ID and/or display name. IDs are project-scoped, case-sensitive and not trimmed. Names alone form a separate identity namespace and are not automatically merged with IDs.

HashedEndUserReference.description: Legacy project-scoped HMAC identity. It is kept separate from supplied IDs and names.

inputTokens.description: Total input tokens, including cache reads and cache creation.

outputTokens.description: Total billable output tokens; reasoning tokens must not be added again.

TokenUsage.description: Null means unknown usage, never zero cost.

post.summary: Accept a batch of SDK events
post.description: One provider attempt per event. Validation is per item; 202 means all valid items were acknowledged by the durable queue, not processed or billed. Retries reuse event UUIDs. Monthly quotas are approximate in beta. Content is discarded before publication. End users may supply a project-scoped ID/name or a legacy HMAC reference. Provider secrets are never accepted.

202.description: Valid events durably accepted; inspect rejected for invalid items. Consumers deduplicate events.

400.description: Malformed JSON, batch envelope, or schema version. Do not retry unchanged.

401.description: Invalid or revoked project key. Stop sending and warn once.

413.description: Split the batch. A single oversized event must be reduced or discarded.

422.description: No valid events. Inspect rejected and do not retry unchanged.

429.description: Request rate or asynchronous monthly quota exceeded.

Retry-After.description: Seconds before retrying. The SDK must also enforce its own maximum buffer age.

503.description: Storage, identity, or admission unavailable. Retry with the same event UUIDs and bounded exponential backoff.

get.description: Requires spend:read. Filters are intersected. UTC dates use an exclusive end, at most 366 days apart. key groups and sdkKeyId refer to Brello ingestion keys, not provider secrets. put.summary: Subscribe a webhook destination to project events
put.description: Owner dashboard session required. First create a webhook destination through organization notification settings and save its one-time signingSecret. Only same-organization webhook destinations can subscribe. An empty eventTypes array disables this subscription and cancels pending public deliveries. Updating resets activation; historical events are not backfilled.

post.description: Brello sends this request to subscribed HTTPS destinations. Verify HMAC-SHA256 using the destination secret over timestamp + '.' + the exact raw UTF-8 request body; the v1 signature is lowercase hex. Compare in constant time and reject timestamps more than 300 seconds from your clock. Deduplicate Brello-Event-Id. Return 2xx to acknowledge. Network errors, 429 and 5xx retry with exponential backoff (up to 8 attempts / 23 hours); other statuses fail permanently. Retry timestamps/signatures change; event ID and payload are stable. Subscriptions are opt-in and do not backfill old events.
